config_name: Gigabyte AERO X16 — Ryzen AI 7 350 / RTX 5070, 48GB RAM, 2TB SSD

specs.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 (8-core: 4 Zen 5 + 4 Zen 5c, Krackan Point)
specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB GDDR7 (85W + 15W Dynamic Boost, MUX switch)
specs.ports: 1x USB4 40Gbps (PD), 2x USB-A 3.0, 1x USB 2.0, HDMI, gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm

battery.notes: 76Wh; same efficient platform as reviewed tier.

price.notes: BBY API-verified 2026-11-24, SKU 20256692 reg $4,480.81 / sale $3,580.81. Marketplace seller — third-party fulfillment/return risk, inflated 'reg' anchor. A related 5070/16GB/1TB marketplace tier (SKU 20340683, $2,507.67) omitted as near-duplicate of the 32GB anchor tier.

reviews.quote: Upgrade options, on the other hand, are very good with expandable RAM and two SSD slots.

praises: 48GB RAM out of the box for heavy editing/multitasking without opening the chassis
2TB standard storage — practical for video projects
Same NBC-reviewed 84% platform: efficient Zen 5 + RTX 5070 with MUX switch
Comfortable keyboard and matte flicker-free 165Hz IPS (NBC)
Still upgradeable to 64GB with two M.2 slots if needed
complaints: Marketplace seller with inflated 'regular' price anchor — the sale price is the real price
RAM premium is steep: +$1,081 sale vs the 32GB/1TB tier for RAM/storage you could add yourself
Same 8GB VRAM GPU bottleneck at this price point (NBC)
Weak webcam, no Wi-Fi 7, USB 2.0 port persists (NBC cons)

design_philosophy: The high-memory AERO X16 tier targets creators who need RAM and storage headroom (video editing, large photo libraries, local models) on the same slim creator-styled Zen 5 chassis NBC reviewed at 84%. In Canada it exists only as a marketplace set at a marked-up anchor — the RAM headroom is the whole premium.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from NBC's Aero X16 1WH review (84%, 32GB/1TB exact platform): +16GB RAM and +1TB storage -> productivity +0.5, creative_work +0.5, ai_ml +0.5 vs anchor tier. All other factors carried from the reviewed config.
standouts: 48GB/2TB creator headroom on the 84%-rated slim platform
dealbreakers: Marketplace markup: ~$1,080 over the 32GB tier for RAM/storage you can install yourself
